_about: brag starter kit: hand-picked Hyperframes registry items for launch videos. role = where it goes in the film; tones = brag tone presets it suits (empty = any).

items.name: headline-slam
items.use: Heavy headline drops in and lands with an impact: a hook that hits on frame 1.

items.name: char-slam-explode
items.use: Scattered glyphs reassemble with overshoot: the hook or the big claim.

items.name: weight-wave
items.use: A wave of font weight rolls through the headline: an elegant title beat.

items.name: kinetic-center-build
items.use: Words push in from the right and build a sentence: a punchy setup line.

items.name: scramble-reveal
items.use: Hacker-style scramble locks into the text: good for dev tools.

items.name: matrix-decode
items.use: Random characters decode left to right into the line.

items.name: overwhelm-surround
items.use: Tasks and pings close in on a calm centre: the 'problem' beat before the reveal.

items.name: glass-shard-title
items.use: Glass shards fly through fog and tile into the title: a trailer-scale opener.

items.name: wireframe-portal-title
items.use: A wireframe portal bursts open and the title comes through.

items.name: vfx-text-cursor
items.use: Dramatic text reveal with cursor glow and light rays.

items.name: cursor-zoom-follow
items.use: Screen-recording auto-zoom: the camera pushes toward each click on the real UI.

items.name: oversized-cursor
items.use: A big macOS arrow lands its click: the 'look here' pointer on the product.

items.name: press-ripple
items.use: A cursor arrives and presses a button with a ripple: the click that triggers the next beat.

items.name: agent-cursor
items.use: An AI agent cursor with a name label operates the UI step by step.

items.name: parallax-device-dive
items.use: A phone rises, then the camera pushes through its screen into the app.

items.name: device-frame-stage
items.use: Phone or tablet mockup staged as a prop with a slot for the real screen.

items.name: multi-device-splay
items.use: Phone, tablet and desktop fan out from a stack: 'works everywhere'.

items.name: screen-flow-carousel
items.use: 2–5 real app screens ride a rail with the primary in focus: a feature tour.

items.name: sticky-mock-swap
items.use: A pinned product mock cross-fades through feature states while captions change.

items.name: modal-morph
items.use: A small card expands into a full panel, shared-element style: container morph.

items.name: ui-3d-reveal
items.use: Perspective reveal for UI elements.

items.name: notification-stack
items.use: Notification cards slide into a stack on cue: results or traction landing.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.use: A card with a cursor spotlight and lit border: focus on one feature.

items.name: terminal-simulator
items.use: Terminal types real commands and streams their output: CLIs and dev tools.

items.name: code-typing
items.use: Token-streamed code typing with a tracking caret.

items.name: code-diff
items.use: A real edit as a coloured diff: before/after for developer products.

items.name: code-morph
items.use: One snippet morphs into another, tokens gliding: 'from this to this'.

items.name: code-snippet-dark-modern
items.use: A full VS Code workbench with per-character typing.

items.name: code-3d-extrude
items.use: Code on a lit 3D slab rotating through space: a hero code moment.

items.name: number-wheel
items.use: A rolling digit counter for metrics, prices, scores.

items.name: mk-progress-stat
items.use: Big-number stat with count-up and a progress track.

items.name: mk-line-graph
items.use: A line graph draws on with value labels riding the front.

items.name: testimonial-proof-card
items.use: A real quote revealed line by line with its avatar and name.

items.name: social-proof-card
items.use: App-store style close: wordmark, stars, a proof line.

items.name: logo-wall
items.use: A 'trusted by' logo wall (replace the placeholders with real logos only).

items.name: whip-pan
items.use: Shader whip pan between scenes: fast, energetic.

items.name: cinematic-zoom
items.use: Shader zoom-blur transition: punching into the next world.

items.name: glitch
items.use: Digital-glitch shader transition.

items.name: light-leak
items.use: Film light-leak transition: warm and premium.

items.name: flash-through-white
items.use: White flash crossfade: a clean payoff cut.

items.name: domain-warp-dissolve
items.use: Fractal-noise warp dissolve: dreamy, high-end.

items.name: iris-reveal
items.use: A circle opens from a chosen point (e.g. the clicked button) to reveal the next scene.

items.name: match-cut
items.use: A circle accelerates into a hard cut and matches the incoming circle: a cut with a cause.

items.name: text-match-cut
items.use: One line of text becomes another mid-move.

items.name: parallax-zoom
items.use: Centre card scales up to fill the frame as siblings fly outward: zoom into a feature.

items.name: cut-the-curve
items.use: Velocity-matched directional hard cut.

items.name: mk-clone-wall-transition
items.use: A tiled word wall covers and inverts the frame: a loud typographic wipe.

items.name: hw-scribble-transition
items.use: Hand-drawn scribble wipe: playful.

items.name: halftone-dissolve
items.use: Scenes dissolve through a growing halftone dot field in the accent colour.

items.name: morph-swap
items.use: One element condenses and reshapes into the next: container morph.

items.name: push-in
items.use: One slow continuous camera push on a headline or the product.

items.name: pull-back-reveal
items.use: Hold a tight detail, then pull back to reveal the whole: detail → context.

items.name: pan-stations
items.use: Lateral camera move across a row of feature stations: replaces 'three cards'.

items.name: camera-shake
items.use: Handheld or impact shake on any wrapper; use on hits only.

items.name: focus-rack
items.use: Focus pulls from one card to another at a different depth.

items.name: beat-accent
items.use: One music-hit sting: flash and scale pulse on the subject. Put it on strong beats.

items.name: motion-blur
items.use: After Effects-style motion blur on fast moves: makes whips and slams feel real.

items.name: grain-overlay
items.use: Film grain texture over everything: warmth.

items.name: light-sweep-pass
items.use: A key-light sweep across a scene or the logo.

items.name: marker-highlight
items.use: A hand-drawn marker stroke under or around the one word that matters.

items.name: mesh-gradient-bg
items.use: Render-safe animated mesh-gradient background in the brand colours.

items.name: dynamic-grid
items.use: Animated grid background for SaaS, code and data products.

items.name: confetti
items.use: A seeded celebration burst on the payoff.

items.name: logo-sting
items.use: Wordmark slams to scale with an accent ring and impact frame.

items.name: logo-brand-close
items.use: Wordmark cascades letter by letter into a centred lockup.

items.name: logo-outro
items.use: Piece-by-piece logo assembly with glow, tagline and URL.

items.name: extruded-logo
items.use: Beveled 3D letters flip up and catch light.

items.name: cta-lockup
items.use: Closing lockup: action line plus an accent CTA capsule (the URL or the command to run).

items.name: store-badge-lockup
items.use: Headline over App Store and Google Play badges.
